item.title: Website management platform Optimizely confirms hackers put malicious code into customer sites
item.description: Researchers said they found malicious JavaScript code on 178 different widely visited websites run through the Optimizely Web experimentation platform. The company confirmed the breach.

item.title: Kazakh ransomware hacking suspect extradited from Italy
item.description: The U.S. accused Roman Khlynovskiy of participating in ransomware attacks against healthcare organizations, schools and companies as part of the "8 Digits Team" connected with INC and Lynx.

item.title: Chinese state group developing automated attack tool for cyber espionage, Google says
item.description: Google released its latest AI Threat Tracker report on Monday, writing that threat actors are rapidly evolving their use of artificial intelligence in attacks — now leaning more heavily on autonomous multi-agent offensive frameworks like Artex, CAIRN, CyberStrikeAI and PentAGI to execute multi-stage intrusions at greater operational velocity.

item.title: California fines Hertz $1.5 million for breaking state data privacy law
item.description: Hertz agreed to the fine and said it would change its business practices, according to a court filing shared by the regulator, the California Privacy Protection Agency (CPPA).

item.title: NSA Net, agency’s classified internal network, faces unspecified disruptions
item.description: The NSA has ordered staggered arrivals at its headquarters at Fort Meade, Maryland, as technicians work to fully restore the classified internal network NSA Net.
